about: CONCEPT images, not photos of what is installed: the owner's AI-generated proposed-transformation images (package Futures_Friends_Center_Transformation_2026-10-07, regenerated 2026-10-07 20:25 after feedback on Lumi's role) of the Futures Friends Learning Zones kit (zone mats, posters, plush) in classrooms laid out like the real Futures Learning Center rooms in img/center/. They replace the earlier Pillow composites, which the owner rejected. Not an installed facility; furnishings and products are concepts, not scale drawings. No people. Always shown with the label and the caption below, and the plain real photo one tap away (brand-art.js photo(): Real room / With the kit). Served at 400/800/1200 px as WebP + JPEG, metadata stripped. Some posters read 'Move. Play. Grow.' as poster art.
